definitions.explanation: Water found beneath the Earth's surface in soil pores and rock fractures.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地下水|ちかすい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飲料|いんりょう}{水|すい}→飲料水：15275_inryousui⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

notes:
{地下水|ちかすい} refers to water found beneath the earth's surface in soil and rock formations. A compound of ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧ (underground) + {水|すい} (water).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地下水|ちかすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{汲|く}み{上|あ}げる: to pump up groundwater
- {地下水|ちかすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧: groundwater contamination
- {地下水|ちかすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{枯渇|こかつ}→枯渇：09458_kokatsu⟧: depletion of groundwater
- {地下水|ちかすい}{脈|みゃく}: underground water vein, aquifer
- {地下水|ちかすい}{位|い}: groundwater level

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many Japanese regions rely on groundwater for drinking water and agriculture. Kumamoto Prefecture is particularly famous for its abundant {地下水|ちかすい}. Excessive pumping (⟦{過剰|かじょう}→過剰：04123_kajou⟧{汲|く}み{上|あ}げ) has caused ⟦{地盤沈下|じばんちんか}→地盤沈下：19197_jibanchinka⟧ (land subsidence) in some urban areas.
